column1: # Java fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). srcmorph counts the pattern's
# matches over the whole source file and writes them as exact facts before the AI summary.
# These are regex heuristics, so the labels are honest: methods are "(approx)" (includes the
# constructors, subtract them), and the field count only sees fields with a strong modifier
# (final-only and package-private fields are not counted, to skip final local variables). A parameter
# list may hold one level of parentheses (@Size(max = 3) String s), read possessively, so the
# constants of a long enum stay linear; "type declarations" counts nested and private types, records
# and @interface too. JavaStructureFactPatternsTest pins the accepted false-positive/negative boundary.
